infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sport Talent uses your location to show games and courts near you and to confirm your check-in when you arrive at a game. You can always search by city instead.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Optional: allow 'Always' so Sport Talent can remind you to check in when you get near a game you joined. We only watch the area around your upcoming games (up to 3) and never track your route. You can check in manually without this.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sport Talent uses the camera to scan the host's check-in QR code at the game.
